deficiencies.description: The rewrite inserts 'because', creating an unsourced causal link between benign tumours being common and the difficulty of a benign tumour becoming malignant.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So benign tumors are actually incredibly common. Right? So it actually takes a lot for a benign tumor to become malignant in terms of, as I said, the number of changes that have to happen within a tumor.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Benign tumours are extremely common, because it takes a great deal for a benign tumour to become malignant, given the number of changes that have to happen within a tumour.
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student would incorrectly learn that benign tumours occur frequently as a result of the difficulty of malignant transformation, rather than these being two distinct observations.

considerations.reason: The phrasing 'A further slide shows the percentage of tumours that result in deaths' accurately conveys what the lecturer stated the slide or figure displayed.
